name: omarchy-mods
description: Example Claude Code mods for Omarchy: desktop notifications with Approve and Deny, package cards with an AUR review hold, run-it-for-me buttons, and a services pane

adapter.title: Adapter
adapter.description: omarchy runs the real Omarchy commands, pacman and ss. fake is for working on the mods on another system and needs stand-in commands on PATH

notify.title: Notifications
notify.description: A desktop notification when Claude finishes, and Approve, Deny and Focus buttons before a permission prompt

package_cards.title: Package cards
package_cards.description: Cards for yay and pacman installs, and the AUR review hold

run_buttons.title: Run-it-for-me buttons
run_buttons.description: Buttons that open a command from a reply, typed but not run, in a floating terminal

services.title: Services pane
services.description: Lists background servers Claude started, with Open and Stop

aur_hold_minutes.title: AUR hold
aur_hold_minutes.description: Minutes an AUR install waits for Install or Cancel before it is refused

approve_wait_seconds.title: Approve wait
approve_wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for an answer on the notification before the normal prompt shows
